# SuperH3 · MiniMax H3 Ref2VA API

> Paid hosted reference-guided video generation. Public snapshot: 2026-11-16 Asia/Shanghai. Refresh https://superh3.com/api/v1/config and https://superh3.com/pricing before use.

- Website/API use the same personal account, key, balance and concurrency. Register, recharge (minimum CNY 5, Alipay) and create your own key. No monthly subscription; paid recharge balance does not expire.
- Current video: Ref2VA only, 1–9 images plus at most 3 audio clips (2s minimum each; 15s combined), no video references. Single images are references, not fixed first frames. No text-only or first/last-frame control.
- Current quality: 768P CNY 0.05/output second; 1080P CNY 0.10/output second (AI upscaled). 480P unavailable. 4–15 whole seconds; six aspect ratios. Every registered user supports 100 concurrent videos; excess accepted tasks queue.
- Batch short-drama shots: 100 fifteen-second outputs total 25 minutes of footage. Up to 100x theoretical parallel throughput assumes independent similarly timed tasks and available capacity; it is not a measured completion time or a finished edited drama.
- Output duration is not processing latency. No current fixed completion-time benchmark is published. Read actual status; never infer progress from elapsed time.
- Hold the confirmed fee at submission, settle on success, release on confirmed failure. Persist idempotency and resume the original task if uncertain.
- Optional H3 Ref2VA 提示词助手: CNY 0.03/request, same API Key; off by default, explicit user_authorized:true and accepted_price:30000 required. One unfinished request per account, sixteen global running, overflow queues. It reads all bound pictures and selected duration and never starts a video.
- Save completed video/text within the receipt's 15-minute retention period. Querying/copying is free.
- API base: https://superh3.com/api/v1 ; public model: superh3. Python/Node/PowerShell clients and seven local stdio MCP tools; no hosted MCP URL.

中文：全能参考；768P每秒0.05元，1080P每秒0.10元；每位注册用户均支持100条视频并发，满额排队。100个15秒镜头合计25分钟素材；理论并行效率最高100倍，实际取决于排队与任务耗时，不保证几分钟交付完整短剧。AI帮写每次0.03元，默认关闭，明确授权才调用；每账号1条未完成，全站16并发。价格和能力以实时配置与报价为准。
